scope: One authorized diagnostic call between two owned accounts, before acceptance. This is a TURN allocation and nonce exchange probe, not a completed WebRTC or proxy test.

liveObservation.executionReportedBy: parent agent controlling the local diagnostic runner

sourceAudit.permissionOrdering: RelayConnInternal.create_perm awaits create_permissions and marks the permission permitted after the transaction returns. Both first sends complete before the fixed second send round starts.
sourceAudit.channelBindOrdering: Channel bind can still be pending. RelayConnInternal.send_to uses a SEND-INDICATION in that state, so delivery does not require the background channel bind to have completed.
sourceAudit.sendLength: The return length can describe the encoded TURN message. The probe checks exact nonce length, content and peer address on receipt instead.
sourceAudit.receiveOrdering: The two receive futures are joined. A timeout establishes that both receives did not complete together within the overall budget; it does not reveal which direction completed or prove that no datagram arrived.
sourceAudit.officialPreAcceptanceBehavior: onReceiveConfig creates the incoming peer connection and sends an offer before acceptance. This supports pre-acceptance connection setup but does not establish the backend's forwarding policy before acceptance.

interpretationLimits: The probe ran before accepting the call. Service-side forwarding eligibility at this point is not verified.
Both allocations originated on the same Windows host. This does not test two independent access networks or isolate service relay hairpin behavior.
The probe makes two fixed sends per direction. Datagram loss and time consumed by allocation cannot be excluded by this result.
The successful local TURN mock proves the probe's fixture path, not compatibility with every service policy or relay deployment.
localCleanupComplete describes local close operations. It is not acknowledgement that every remote allocation was deleted, especially after a cancelled operation.
The earlier accepted WebRTC call failed ICE. The pre-acceptance raw TURN timeout neither exonerates ICE nor establishes that both failures share one cause.
No provider-blocking, account-policy, billing, throughput or final root-cause conclusion follows from this single probe.
nextDiagnostic: Only after separate authorization and source review, compare a fresh account-bound probe after acceptance while retaining the same bounded nonce-only destinations and exact encrypted call cleanup. No additional live attempt is recorded here.
